name: Multi-Material Dual Contouring
definition: A method to model solids composed of multiple materials by replacing the binary signs ($-$ and $+$) in the grid with material indices. Each grid point has an index corresponding to a distinct material.
summary: Multi-Material Dual Contouring extracts textured meshes from volumetric data by replacing binary occupancy with material indices and using QEF minimization to place vertices at material intersections.
